# Musical Time Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame`](gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MusicalTimeFrame>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A reference frame for musical time — a one-dimensional rational-position axis relative to which durations, spans, tempi, and mappings are expressed. Per-voice frames are supported via [`gmeow:isHostedBy`](../properties/gmeow-isHostedBy.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame`](gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
